notes.title: New Update out now!
notes.content:
Hey players,
in today's update I fixed some bugs.

- When clicking restart, the number of rounds played was not counted, that has now been fixed.
- The store now shows the coins you own. So you do not have to go to the statistics to see how much you have.
- In the store the text "Selected" has been changed to "Active".
- The background was made a little brighter in the game, so that you can now see the skins properly and they do not disappear in the black.
- In addition, a build for German players was created with a German translation.

I thank you again hugely players who have given me plenty of feedback on the game. :) The leaderboard must fill slowly times. :P
